caption:
Where did today's hours actually go?

By time, mankind is in loss, except those who believe, do righteous deeds, and exhort one another to truth and to patience. Listen once, then look back at your day.

Surah Al-Asr 103:1-3

Send this to the friend who keeps you on track

#surahasr #quranrecitation #timeisprecious #reminder

Recitation: Abdul Rahman Al-Sudais
